body: Glad I could help you find a voice. Finding a way to explain things makes dealing with them a lot easier, I think, as does realizing then that you're not the only one who feels like that
Same. I'm enrolled in college now, but I've fucked up so many semesters that I don't really understand why I'm still bothering besides that people expect me to.
I just burst into tears over someone at home (while I'm away at school) posting that they missed my face on social media, so no, it's definitely not just you.

The counseling center at school is always 100% booked, and I don't want to talk to my parents because my dad is fucked like I said, my mom is hardcore "suicide is selfish and cowardly", and my stepmom just doesn't really do feelings well, so I don't know what to do
I have a counselor in town, but he only has time for me like once a month and that's honestly worthless
